description.value:
You can convert between your two resources.

Creating Tech Points. As a bonus action, you may turn a single use of your Potent Aptitude into two tech points; these can push you above your normal maximum, but any created this way vanish once you finish a short rest.

Creating Potent Aptitude. As a bonus action, you may spend two tech points to gain one use of your Potent Aptitude.
